title: Comparing shape and length
description: A small set of options helps consider an item next to your own wardrobe.

blocks.text: The review describes the benefit of an explanation on one’s own example: a person decided to try styles they used to avoid. The idea of comparing length and cut develops that request, but the review itself does not confirm a need for an accurate virtual try-on.

quote.text: knowing what suits my body type changed how I feel getting dressed. used to avoid certain styles thinking they wouldnt work but lumi explained how to make them work for ME. feel way more put together now

blocks.text: Show on a familiar outfit how a different length or shape looks, and explain what changed. Leave the choice to the person and keep their preference, without tying it rigidly to a “correct” body type.
What the image does not show

A picture like that cannot be used to check the fit or how the fabric feels on the body. If what a person needs is to choose a size, that calls for a different way of checking, not a more convincing illustration.
